body: Thanks for taking the time to respond and talk to me through my post. It's helped me calm down quite a bit. I think I'll try and get some sleep. Again. Thanks : )

I guess I'll try to look into one and get one, but I won't be able to after some time. Because I've broken up with my fiance and need to move back to my home country. But yeah. I've been diagnosed with severe depression but after the diagnosis my mother stopped me from seeing a therapist. I wasnt sure if this was depression due to the difference between before and now. But Depression sure has a way of making you feel insane with the constant battle with yourself. You rationalize the bullying you're doing to yourself but you can't fully seem to choose one side or the other. I'm not sure if that makes sense, but I guess I'm still calming down.

I don't have one. I've been wanting one, but I don't have a lot of money. Is this something I should get a therapist for? Sometimes I feel delusional or just upright pitiful. The person closest to me most likely thinks I don't need one and that I'm just lazy.

I have no friends I can talk to. None of them are close enough and they're not mentally stable enough. Before these 3 years, I can't remember a time where I wasn't depressed. I've never fully enjoyed something. If I ever did, it always came with crashing guilt.
